description.ncbi_summary: SEPT14 is a member of the highly conserved septin family of GTP-binding cytoskeletal proteins implicated in membrane transport, apoptosis, cell polarity, cell cycle regulation, cytokinesis, and other cellular functions (Peterson et al., 2007 [PubMed 17922164]).[supplied by OMIM, Jul 2008].

uniprot_function.text: Filament-forming cytoskeletal GTPase (Probable). Involved in the migration of cortical neurons and the formation of neuron leading processes during embryonic development (By similarity). Plays a role in sperm head formation during spermiogenesis, potentially via facilitating localization of ACTN4 to cell filaments (PubMed:33228246).
